platform: Ubuntu 24.04.3 WSL2, i686 GCC 13.3, private Xvfb and llvmpipe

openal.license: LGPL-2.0-or-later, already recorded for this pinned dependency

syntheticSource.format: mono PCM16 little-endian WAV, 48000 Hz, 48000 frames

runs.script:
wait 120
renderer_switch
s_info
s_stop
wait 60
wait 240
set fs_debug 0
echo LINUX_AUDIO_COMPLETE
quit

analysis.method: Exclude the first 3 seconds after startup/restart. The no-tone control contains menu speech and its decaying tail before then (up to two PCM units between 2.5 and 3 seconds), and is exactly silent afterward. The script stops menu audio at 120 frames and waits 60 more before playing. Tone spectrum uses a centered 100 ms Hann window zero-padded to one-Hz bins.

buildNote: The system has only x86-64 OpenAL. The already pinned, LGPL-compatible 1.25.2 source was built privately for i686 after verifying all 461 upstream files against the cached archive. No system package or production binary was changed.
initialProbeLimits: The first assertion expected an older Wave File Writer device label; this runtime uses OpenAL Soft and identifies the actual wave backend in its own log.
An initial soundinfo command was corrected to the registered s_info command before the final runs.
With fs_debug 1 at shutdown, qconsole.log was reopened and truncated after closing; final runs restore fs_debug 0 before quit and retain stdout independently.
The no-tone control includes menu speech and a decaying tail during the excluded first three seconds.
limitations: Output is a file-rendered backend measurement, not listening or physical audio-device evidence.
The two language probes establish selected MP3 path and nonzero output, not complete-utterance or perceptual equivalence.
The restart WAV contains the final device opening because the writer replaces its output when reopened.
No Linux SP or Bink support claim; native SP remains Windows x86.
safety: Only the engine test stream is written; no microphone, system-output capture, or other application audio is recorded.
The private runtime contains null/wave backends only and the probe explicitly selects wave.
Windowed private Xvfb, mouse/joystick disabled, read-only assets, isolated E:/Games test homes; no proprietary media committed.
